item.title: Bulletin updated at 13:00 HKT 24/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An active southerly airstream will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China tomorrow. Besides, an anticyclone aloft will strengthen early to midweek next week. It will be hot and brighter over the coast of southern China. With the weakening of the anticyclone aloft, there will be more showers over the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. The area of low pressure now over the western North Pacific will move towards the vicinity of the Philippines in the next couple of days. However, its subsequent development and movement are rather uncertain.
